title: fix(objectql): a free-text search resolves only over the fields the caller may query
body:
Fixes #25672

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

A free-text `search` now resolves only over the fields the caller may query. `expandSearchOnAst` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`) asks the registered `security` service's `getQueryableFields(object, context)` and passes the answer to `expandSearchToFilter` as `queryableFields`. `search-filter.ts` then withholds every resolved field outside that set. The answer is read through the engine's existing `SECURITY_SERVICE_SOURCE_SLOT`, and the context is the one the middleware will see. This applies to `find`, `findOne`, `count` and `aggregate`.

- **One readability source.** `getQueryableFields` is the published complement of what the field-read predicate guard refuses (same `computeQueryGuardFieldPerms` derivation), and `searchAll` already narrows with it. The engine adds no second field-permission rule.
- **The guard is unchanged.** It still judges every predicate the caller wrote.
- **Named fields are not withheld.** A field the caller names in `searchFields` (either spelling) reaches the guard and is refused with 403, as before.
- **Narrowing happens after resolution.** A declared set that is entirely hidden stays empty and does not fall through to the auto-default.
- **Empty set.** A set withheld down to nothing answers the existing #24284 refusal (`400 INVALID_FIELD`, `param: search`), with a message that names field-level security as the cause.
- **No answer, no narrowing.** No context, no service, no method, or an `undefined` answer leaves the set as it is, and the guard decides as today.

## Proof (fresh boot, `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh`, a non-admin org member vs the seeded admin)

| Request | Member | Admin |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user?search=Mia` | 200, Mia Member | 200, same row |
| `?search=admin@objectos` (email) | 200, Dev Admin | n/a |
| console shape `populate=primary_business_unit_id&top=25&search=Adm&filter=["banned","!=",true]` | 200, Dev Admin | 200, same row |
| `?filter=["ban_reason","=","x"]` | **403** `PERMISSION_DENIED` (guard holds) | n/a |
| `?search=x&$searchFields=ban_reason` | **403** naming `ban_reason` | n/a |
| `?search=x&searchFields=name,role` | **403** naming `role` | n/a |
| `?search=user` | n/a | 200, both users (matched on `role`: the admin's set is unchanged) |

- **Ablation.** I replaced `{ ...expandOptions, queryableFields }` with `{ ...expandOptions }` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `7383042fc6ad` → `cf902b78f292`), rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` passed. Re-booted, the member's three searches answered **403 `... not readable by the caller: role, ban_reason, last_login_ip`**, the card's exact refusal. The admin rows matched the fixed run byte for byte, ids aside.
- **Restore.** `git checkout HEAD --`, disk blob `7383042fc6ad` = HEAD blob, `git status --porcelain` empty, rebuilt, and the preflight finds the marker in `dist/core.{js,mjs}`.
- **Generality.** The second object is a unit-level proof (`engine-search-queryable-fields.test.ts`: an auto-default object loses its hidden `private_note`). The CRM example has no non-`sys_user` object with a member-hidden searchable field to drive over HTTP.

## Tests (at `61177d0f12`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run`: 468/468 files, 8719/8719 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0, test layer included.
- `plugin-security`: 222 files, 4628 passed, 45 skipped. `plugin-audit`: 60 files, 985 passed. Both use the rebuilt objectql `dist`.
- New: `engine-search-queryable-fields.test.ts` (each verb, generality, named-field pass-through, every no-answer road, blank term, all-withheld → 400) and 4 cases in `search-filter.test.ts`.

## Gates

- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 73 derived, all run, all exit 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 73/73 with exit codes, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- Two families (`check-engine-split-ratio`, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`) first refused on the shallow clone and passed after `git fetch --unshallow`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the four touched files: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` is untouched: the general route made the narrower one unnecessary, so there is no overlap with #25626.
- `count` narrows with the same set, so the paged `total` agrees with `records` for a member.
- `getQueryableFields` withholds masked fields too, matching the guard: a member's search no longer matches on a field they see masked, where it used to 403.
